Bramblewood Effects Lab

Every animation, light, shader and sound in the game so far, live. Cards here use the game's own stylesheet and art. Hover the foil cards, press the buttons, and use headphones for the sound section. Status: Live in the game, Partly built, Idea not built yet.

Combat skills new

Choreographed skill effects. Arrow and Fire Arrow are now live in the game with this exact animation: the archer draws (leans back while the arrow is pulled along the line of fire), releases with a snap-forward recoil and a bowstring ring, the arrow arcs and accelerates, then sticks and quivers as the target is knocked back. The rest are new prototypes for skills we have, ready to wire in.

SkillStatusBeats
🏹 ArrowLiveDraw (lean back, arrow pulled) → release, recoil, string ring → arcing, accelerating flight → stick, quiver, knock-back, splinters
🔥 Fire ArrowLiveAs Arrow, plus a flame lit on the tip while drawing, an ember trail, a burst of flame, an ignite ring and a scorched edge on the target
🏹🏹 VolleyPrototypeOne draw, three arrows released in quick succession at up to three targets
➶ PiercePrototypeThe arrow passes through the first target and flies on into the next
🧪 Poison dartPrototypeA thin green dart with dripping trail; green splash ring on hit
❄️ Frost boltPrototypeA spinning ice shard; shatters into frost and leaves a frosted card for a moment
⚡ Chain lightningPrototypeA flickering forked bolt jumping card to card
🪃 Anti-Air boomerangLiveA spinning boomerang hooks up into the flier on a low curve, feathers fly, and it swings back on a higher one (whirr out and back)
🛡️ Shield CallLiveA big shield drops from above into the slot, lands with a squash and a dust ring, then a ring of metal
🗡️ BackstabLiveA dagger flashes in from the attacker's side and leaves a thin red slash; the target is shoved away from it
❄️ / ☠ Element deathsLiveCold deaths shed ice shards with a glassy crack; poison deaths drip green as the card melts
💚 Heal · 🛡️ Shield up · 🚩 RallyPrototypeRising pluses and rings; a shield dome; a banner with golden chevrons rising through allies

Damage numbers new

Each number bursts out of the hit, then recoils back to size; the burst behind it fades fast. An icon in front says what kind of hit it was. On the enemy row numbers pop higher on the card; on yours they spread out more sideways. Press a button to hit the card.

Deaths: bleed-out and burn-away Live

⏳
🦦
Otter Centurion
⚔3❤9

Normal: the card topples back in one smooth fall until it lies flat, greys out and puffs leaves and dust. Bleed / poison / cold: a dark wash runs down and drops fall, red, green or icy by cause. Burn: fire deaths burn away from the bottom with embers.

Card deaths; burn also on a falling castle

⚔2❤3

Battlefield shaders

Sound effects

All synthesised live in the browser (no files yet). Tap to hear each one.

Rival voices

Music Live

Every note is composed or generated here and played by small synthesised instruments, so the whole library is ours: no samples, no licences, nothing to download. Use headphones.

Songbook: place themes

Written melodies that loop with small variations; each plays in its own place and crossfades when you move.

Battle music: one band per people

Improvised live, at three intensities: calm, drums join (round 5+ or a castle under 60%), full (sudden death or a castle under 30%).

Home

Home keeps the endless calm piano: a new short piece in a new key every minute or so.

Ambience

Continuous soundscapes per place. One plays at a time.
